defects.title: 86 grant noise rule (every normal 86 produces a grant row) lacks PO approval evidence
defects.invariant: Business rule changes that generate grant rows for every normal 86 must have explicit Product Owner approval documented
defects.mechanism: The rule "Plana aykırı kuralı = aktif her ürünün 86'lanması; her normal 86 bir grant satırı üretir" is documented in low-A.md as accepted but the reason states "86 grant gürültüsünün PO onayı kanıtsız" (PO approval for 86 grant noise is unproven). The finding B044/V1-KIT-008 was marked [Düşük] and accepted in the markdown but no evidence of PO sign-off exists in the source references.
defects.acceptance: Either (a) produce documented PO approval for the 86 grant noise rule with date and approver identity, or (b) reclassify the rule as unverified/blocked until PO approval is obtained. The acceptance evidence must be a traceable decision record, not a markdown claim.

limitations: The defect is a process/governance gap: the rule exists in code/markdown as 'accepted' but the PO approval claimed in the markdown cannot be verified from the repository artifacts. No external PO approval artifact was found in evidence/V1-RMD-739 or linked tasks.
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
